units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 15:1">Targ. Gen. XV, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:10">B. Mets. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ נטר ליה</he> compensation for waiting (giving time for delivery), i.e. advancing the money to the seller.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 68b:15">Ib. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>פלגא בא׳ כ׳</he> half profit or loss.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 69b:12">Ib. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ ופגרא</he> payment for carrying freight, and indemnity to the boatsmen in case of wreck.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:3:2">Y. M. Kat. II, 81ᵇ</cite> top <he>א׳ וקרנא</he> profit and principal (cost-price).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:3">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> top <he>מא׳ כל הדין עלמא</he> than all profit this world can offer.
Ber. 6ᵇ א׳ דפירקא ריהטא the merit in attending a lecture lies in running [to it] (anxiety to hear it). [אֲגַר, אַגְרָא staff, pole, v. אגד.]
